title: PDV Phase 20 Orc life-mode and Malacath parity implementation costing
designRules: Malacath is the religious spine; depth comes from life mode, not deity shopping.
Stronghold, City, and Legion/Exile need distinct value, not one full route and two weaker variants.
Forge rewards require quality, context, value, or commission filters.
City and Legion/Exile play must show dignity, service, and self-made community instead of missing stronghold status.
Werewolf can be judged by the code; vampire remains outside the test until cured.

Mode ceiling rate multipliers are LOCKED in ProcessDawn (pre-clamp): Stronghold x1.00, City x0.75, Legion/Exile x0.60 of base; thresholds (25/50/85) are identical across modes. Calendars: Stronghold 10/20/34, City 13/27/45, Legion/Exile 17/33/57. See PDV_PietyPaceBalancingTable.md and PDV_SignalDensityAudit.md.

notes: Only one life-mode scoring lane can be active at a time.
Reuses the skeleton scaffold record already present in the framework ESP.
Switches should resolve through world evidence or setup confirmation, then soft-lock briefly.
Existing skeleton global mirrors the active life mode for records, dialogue conditions, and Survey Devotion.

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Malacath devotion is dignity under pressure across Stronghold, City, and Legion or Exile life.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Quality labor, kinship crisis, service pressure, and self-made community are proofs of code and dignity, not generic crafting or faction reward.
Life-mode rewards explain where the Orc belongs right now while keeping Malacath as the religious spine.
feedbackSurface: Survey/status distinguishes Stronghold, City, and LegionExile life modes.
Quiet favor copy handles labor and dignity; marked favor copy handles Blood-Kin crisis or exile burden.
rejectedGenericBehavior: mode chosen only from MCM without world confirmation
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A City or Legion/Exile Orc has a complete devotional life through dignity, service, quality labor, and self-made belonging beside Stronghold play.
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Do not ship Stronghold-only Orc depth; prove one Stronghold beat and one City or Legion/Exile parity beat with rejected craft, kill, and membership loops.

rules: life-mode enum/readback exists and is wired before mode-specific rewards ship
four Orc proof ACTI records route through EventSignalActivator and EventBus
Stronghold, City, and Legion/Exile have at least one proofable favor family each
forge and combat hooks include quality/context filters and caps

a City Orc can receive dignity, quality labor, or self-made community recognition
a Legion/Exile Orc can receive service pressure and return-burden recognition

ordinary city presence or ambient insult text does not create City-mode reward

firstImplementationSlice: Wire Orc life-mode state/readback and status copy.
Implement Stronghold forge, City dignity, Legion/Exile service, and self-made community proof surfaces before any Stronghold-only expansion.
Add anti-farm assertions for raw crafting, generic kills, generic patrols, and MCM-only mode choice.
Keep vampire and werewolf curse posture separate from normal life-mode scoring.
